services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Bottom fishing is a fishery that you never know what you might catch, usually ling cod and various species of rock cod and bass but sometimes it can be a salmon, halibut, wolf eel even sea cucumbers or sometimes starfish or a rock….. April 1st is when our Ling Cod fishery opens. Its a great way to start the season, spend sometime or the day bottom fishing for Ling Cod and Rock Cod and also fish for some salmon too. Some people prefer the white meat you get from a ling cod over the meat you get from a halibut.
